research_scope: Gigantic Slam — Strike Super / unavailable-for-CaC classification research.

verification_audit.method: Compared repository exact-name research coverage with current Xenoverse 2-specific skill documentation and independent Dragon Ball documentation.

duplicate_check.identity_note: No existing repository research batch for Gigantic Slam was found. The canonical identity is Super / Strike; unavailable-for-CaC status is retained as a separate catalog characteristic.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2-specific documentation classifies Gigantic Slam as a Strike Super and separately lists it as unavailable for CaC.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The skill is a Broly-exclusive Super and is not obtainable by the Future Warrior. Current documentation lists no CaC unlock route; later Partner Customization makes it available for Broly custom presets, not CaC.
verification_audit.finish_policy: ultimate_finish_required remains null because no Future Warrior acquisition route is established.
verification_audit.cost_policy: The documented Ki cost is 100; stamina cost remains null because the reviewed canonical documentation does not establish a reliable stamina value.

records.name: Gigantic Slam
records.character_source: Broly / Broly (Supervillain) / Broly (Full Power Super Saiyan) customizable partner
records.skill_description: A close-range grab Strike Super in which Broly seizes the opponent and slams them downward with a Ki Wave.
records.mechanics_notes: The Xenoverse 2 skill reference describes a face grab followed by a downward slam and Ki Blast impact. It is categorized as a grab Super and leaves the user exposed after the attack. Exact frame and damage values are not promoted to canonical numeric data.
records.acquisition_notes: Gigantic Slam is unobtainable for the Future Warrior/CaC. Later Partner Customization availability applies to Broly custom presets and does not constitute a CaC unlock route.
records.pve_notes: Cast/partner-only skill; no CaC Parallel Quest, Skill Shop, mentor, or Shenron acquisition route established.
records.pvp_notes: Close-range grab with a Ki Wave follow-up; detailed matchup and frame behavior remains version-sensitive.
